scope: Memory discovery through the real fresh ResumableStage and optional concurrent live-view preparation, with SQLite writing held stopped. Excludes database catch-up, AppKit/SwiftUI rendering and cold-filesystem performance.

protocol.order: alternating baseline/candidate per round; unmeasured warmup of both variants before measurement
protocol.fixtures: Real local APFS files: flat 60,008 records; mixed 90,068 records, including hardlinks, sparse files, symlinks, Unicode and long names. Each run verified against an independent lstat inventory and deduplicated live allocated totals.
protocol.timing: Discovery after stage construction; initialization and first visible rows reported separately. No build or test processes overlapped measured runs. Filesystem metadata warm; no system cache purge.
protocol.memory: RSS includes the whole process at discovery completion. Pending-byte estimate excludes batches waiting for an earlier directory ticket.
protocol.tradeoff: Four workers use more CPU to reduce elapsed time. These fixtures do not predict whole-home, network-volume or cold-storage latency.
